title: 64c88ae4/T2: gf2 criterion benchmark suite (all ops × fields × sizes)
description:
Second task of story `64c88ae4`. Criterion bench suite on the gf2 side covering every (operation, field, size) combination, in both full-rank and rank-deficient regimes.

## Deliverables

- **`crates/gf2-core/benches/fieldmatrix_gemm.rs`** — matmul at 64², 256², 1024², 4096²; plus rectangular (1024 × 1024 × 1024^0.5), (1024 × 1024 × 1024^0.3).
- **`crates/gf2-core/benches/fieldmatrix_ple.rs`** — PLE / rank / nullspace / rref at 64², 256², 1024², 4096²; full-rank and rank n/2.
- **`crates/gf2-core/benches/fieldmatrix_solve.rs`** — inv / solve / det.
- **`crates/gf2-core/benches/fieldmatrix_charpoly.rs`** — charpoly / minpoly at 32², 128², 512².
- **`crates/gf2-core/benches/sparse_spmv.rs`** — SpMV at sparsity 1%, 5% and n = 256, 1024, 4096.
- **CSV emitter** — each bench writes to `bench_results/gf2-<timestamp>.csv` in the same schema as T1's reference output.
- **Seeded matrix generators** matching T1's harness — identical inputs across libs.

## Field coverage

Per story `64c88ae4`: GF(7), GF(31), GF(251), GF(65521), GF(2^31−1), GF(2^8), GF(2^16), GF(2^32).

## Success criteria

- [hard] Every (operation, field, size) combo from the story bench matrix has a criterion bench.
- [hard] Rank-deficient regime exercised for every factorization op.
- [hard] Seeded matrix generators produce identical data to T1's reference harness (verify via a small doctest checking a hash of the first row at seed 0).
- [hard] CSV output schema matches T1.

## Depends on

- `d48a3cfd` (matmul; full story, not just T1).
- `c3f8c1cb` (PLE + echelon).
- `83b1ad8b` (trsm).

- `8a90882e` (sparse).
